decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - Within 1 month of the demolition of buildings forming part of J Block hereby permitted, the proposed treatment and surfacing of the land upon which each building was located shall be implemented in accordance with the details contained in the letters dated 14 January 2002.

Condition : 4 - The areas formerly occupied by these J Block buildings and to be hard surfaced shall not be used for the purposes of car parking without the further written grant of consent form the local planning authority.
description: Resurfacing works on site of proposed demolition of buildings
